cases.query: Smí dvě aplikace komunikovat napřímo, bez integrační platformy?
expectedFacts: Direct point-to-point communication between different applications is forbidden; incoming communication must go through an approved integration solution.
Direct communication is allowed only between internal components of the same application.
cases.note: Drafted 2026-10-27 from integration-rules.md / integration-patterns-guide.md; expectedFacts reviewed by the application-integration domain expert 2026-10-27.

cases.query: What is the default integration style between systems, and how must APIs be described?
expectedFacts: REST APIs and Kafka are the default integration approaches.
cases.note: Drafted 2026-10-27 from integration-rules.md / integration-patterns-guide.md; expectedFacts reviewed by the application-integration domain expert 2026-10-27.

cases.query: Která hlavička je povinná při volání API přes API Management?
expectedFacts: The Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header is mandatory on every API request through APIM; it is issued based on an approved subscription.
cases.note: Drafted 2026-10-27 from integration-rules.md / integration-patterns-guide.md; expectedFacts reviewed by the application-integration domain expert 2026-10-27.

cases.query: Jaké způsoby autentizace API Management ověřuje a jsou povinné?
expectedFacts: Subscription key is mandatory. OIDC and mTLS are optional and depend on the API's confidentiality;
cases.note: Drafted 2026-10-27 from integration-rules.md / integration-patterns-guide.md; expectedFacts reviewed by the application-integration domain expert 2026-10-27.

cases.query: Can TLS be omitted between API Management and the backend service?
expectedFacts: TLS between APIM and the backend may be omitted for performance only if the connection is secured by trusted network boundaries.
cases.note: Drafted 2026-10-27 from integration-rules.md / integration-patterns-guide.md; expectedFacts reviewed by the application-integration domain expert 2026-10-27.

cases.query: Mám integraci mezi dvěma aplikacemi, konzument nepotřebuje okamžité potvrzení doručení a nepotřebuji garantované zpracování. Jaký vzor použít?
expectedFacts: Use event streaming (log-based), e.g. Škoda Kafka or Azure Event Hubs.
cases.note: Drafted 2026-10-27 from integration-rules.md / integration-patterns-guide.md; expectedFacts reviewed by the application-integration domain expert 2026-10-27.

cases.query: Is gRPC allowed between two different applications?
expectedFacts: gRPC is allowed within the same application boundary (same LeanIX ID) but is discouraged or restricted across application boundaries.
cases.note: Drafted 2026-10-27 from integration-rules.md / integration-patterns-guide.md; expectedFacts reviewed by the application-integration domain expert 2026-10-27.

cases.query: Šifruje Kafka obsah zpráv? Jak mám přenášet citlivá data?
expectedFacts: Kafka does not provide payload encryption.
Secret data must be encrypted by the producer and decrypted by the consumer.
cases.note: Drafted 2026-10-27 from integration-rules.md / integration-patterns-guide.md; expectedFacts reviewed by the application-integration domain expert 2026-10-27.

cases.query: How do I authenticate to the Škoda Kafka platform?
expectedFacts: Kafka supports OAuth2 via ŠKODA IdP and mTLS/SSL with client certificates.
cases.note: Drafted 2026-10-27 from integration-rules.md / integration-patterns-guide.md; expectedFacts reviewed by the application-integration domain expert 2026-10-27.

cases.query: Jaké je SLA a podpora Kafka platformy?
expectedFacts: Infrastructure SLA is 99.95%.
Infrastructure support is 24x7; customer care is 8x5.
cases.note: Drafted 2026-10-27 from integration-rules.md / integration-patterns-guide.md; expectedFacts reviewed by the application-integration domain expert 2026-10-27.

cases.query: Jak požádat o prostupnost firewallu mezi on-premise aplikací a API Managementem v Mladé Boleslavi?
expectedFacts: Firewall access is requested via UMS Form 9031.
API providers request access from API Management to the backend; consumers request access from the application to API Management.
cases.note: Drafted 2026-10-27 from integration-rules.md / integration-patterns-guide.md; expectedFacts reviewed by the application-integration domain expert 2026-10-27.

cases.query: What happens to the Azure self-hosted APIM gateway if it loses connectivity to Azure?
expectedFacts: It keeps serving traffic from its in-memory configuration (fail-static).
With a local backup enabled it can also survive a restart during the outage.
cases.note: Drafted 2026-10-27 from integration-rules.md / integration-patterns-guide.md; expectedFacts reviewed by the application-integration domain expert 2026-10-27.

cases.query: Can I still use the AWS Europe Central 1 API gateway?
expectedFacts: The AWS Europe Central 1 gateway is deprecated across all environments.
cases.note: Drafted 2026-10-27 from integration-rules.md / integration-patterns-guide.md; expectedFacts reviewed by the application-integration domain expert 2026-10-27.

cases.query: Jak vystavit existující API jako MCP server pro AI asistenty?
expectedFacts: Scenario 1: wrap an existing REST API published in APIM in an MCP layer — for standard internal APIs, no extra infrastructure for the team.
Scenario 2: the application team operates its own MCP server and registers it in APIM — for complex or performance-sensitive cases needing full control.
cases.note: Drafted 2026-10-27 from integration-rules.md / integration-patterns-guide.md; expectedFacts reviewed by the application-integration domain expert 2026-10-27.

cases.query: Co musí splňovat externí (periferní) aplikace, se kterou se integrujeme?
expectedFacts: It must be registered in ŠkoNET and LeanIX.
It must have an assigned Product Owner and IT Product Manager who are employees of Škoda, take responsibility for the application and its compliance.
cases.note: Drafted 2026-10-27 from integration-rules.md / integration-patterns-guide.md; expectedFacts reviewed by the application-integration domain expert 2026-10-27.
